rules.baseline: Enter while completed 4H WT1 > WT2; exit on completed 4H bearish crossover.
rules.ema20: Baseline entry AND completed 4H close > EMA(close,20). Baseline WT exit.
rules.dmi14: Baseline entry AND Wilder +DI(14) > -DI(14). Baseline WT exit.
rules.dmi_adx: DMI14 entry condition AND ADX(14) > its previous completed 4H value. Baseline WT exit.
rules.atr_exit: Baseline entries. Sell at next 4H open after either WT red cross or close < trailing stop. Stop = max(previous stop, highest completed high since entry - 2 * ATR(14)). After an ATR exit wait for a new WT green cross before re-entry; no intrabar stop execution.
rules.price_confirmation: Baseline entry AND close strictly above the most recent WT green crossover candle high in the current bullish phase. Re-evaluate at each completed close; red cross cancels setup. Baseline WT exit.
